source.claimBoundary: The workbench reconstructs the visible method pipeline; it does not claim pixel-perfect or source-identical replication.

graduationTest: Remove the teacher page; the extracted target-field, active-tip, local-grammar, split, stop and load-backprop capabilities must remain callable from the instrument.
pipeline: multiple active tips compete for nearby targets
true branch split when target groups diverge
new structure changes later spatial decisions
downstream load is back-propagated into thickness
criticalBoundaries: Target points are Supply / Opportunity Field samples, not a literal natural cause.
Following the nearest point is pathfinding, not sufficient evidence of branching growth.
L-System contributes local state and recursive grammar; fixed strings/angles are not universal natural law.
Wave contributes continuous direction change and must not create branch topology by itself.
Randomness only perturbs decisions; it does not create naturalness without local purpose, history, field, load and stopping rules.
The teacher is shared across objects, but object parameters and biological causality remain separate Scores.
treeLearning: leaf/fruit organs restricted to valid terminal zones
coralLearning: coarse support axes to dense terminal network
validationClaims: true branch split count greater than zero
tree/coral/neutral Scores change the output without changing the teacher engine
